title: thuja occidentalis f. lutea
intro: Thuja occidentalis f. lutea, commonly known as Yellow Arborvitae, is a yellow-leaved variant of the Eastern White Cedar tree (Thuja occidentalis) native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory actions. The health benefits of Thuja occidentalis f. lutea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including thujone, borneol, and bornyl acetate, which exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant also include its ability to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing.
